SELECT d00, d01, d02, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(i10) AS s_i10, SUM(i11) AS s_i11, SUM(i12) AS s_i12, SUM(i13) AS s_i13, SUM(i15) AS s_i15, AVG(f10) AS a_f10, AVG(f11) AS a_f11, AVG(f12) AS a_f12, AVG(f13) AS a_f13, AVG(f14) AS a_f14, MIN(f15) AS mn_f15, MAX(f16) AS mx_f16, MIN(i16) AS mn_i16, MAX(i17) AS mx_i17, SUM(f17) AS s_f17, SUM(f18) AS s_f18, AVG(i18) AS a_i18, COUNT(x00) AS c_x00, MIN(d10) AS mn_d10, MAX(ts) AS mx_ts FROM events_wide GROUP BY d00, d01, d02 ORDER BY d00, d01, d02
SELECT h00, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(f00) AS s FROM events_wide GROUP BY h00 ORDER BY s DESC, h00 LIMIT 100
SELECT i02, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(f01) AS s FROM events_wide GROUP BY i02 ORDER BY n DESC, i02 LIMIT 100
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT h01) AS u_email, COUNT(DISTINCT h05) AS u_acct FROM events_wide
SELECT d01, COUNT(DISTINCT h05) AS u FROM events_wide GROUP BY d01 ORDER BY d01
SELECT SUM(n00) AS s0, SUM(n01) AS s1, SUM(n02) AS s2, SUM(n03) AS s3, AVG(n04) AS a4 FROM events_wide
SELECT d02, SUM(n05) AS s5, SUM(n06) AS s6, MIN(n07) AS m7, MAX(n08) AS x8 FROM events_wide GROUP BY d02 ORDER BY d02

SELECT a.tier AS tier_a, b.tier AS tier_b, c.label AS label_c, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(e.f00) AS s FROM events_wide e JOIN dim_d03 a ON a.k = e.d03 JOIN dim_d04 b ON b.k = e.d04 JOIN dim_d07 c ON c.k = e.d07 WHERE a.active AND b.weight > 1 AND c.tier = 't1' GROUP BY a.tier, b.tier, c.label ORDER BY s DESC, tier_a, tier_b, label_c LIMIT 50
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(b.f01) AS s FROM events_wide a JOIN events_wide b ON b.id = a.i20 WHERE a.i05 < 5
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(b.f02) AS s FROM events_wide a JOIN events_wide b ON b.h00 = a.h07
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM events_wide a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events_wide b WHERE b.id = a.i20 AND b.b00)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM events_wide a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM events_wide b WHERE b.id = a.i20 AND b.i05 = 0)
SELECT d04, id, f05, rn FROM (SELECT d04, id, f05, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d04 ORDER BY f05 DESC, id) AS rn FROM events_wide) t WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY d04, rn
SELECT d07, id, i06, rk FROM (SELECT d07, id, i06, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d07 ORDER BY i06 DESC) AS rk FROM events_wide) t WHERE rk <= 2 ORDER BY d07, rk, id
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(rs) AS total, MAX(rs) AS mx FROM (SELECT SUM(f06) OVER (PARTITION BY d00 ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rs FROM events_wide) t
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(nx - pv) AS d FROM (SELECT LAG(i08) OVER (PARTITION BY d05 ORDER BY id) AS pv, LEAD(i08) OVER (PARTITION BY d05 ORDER BY id) AS nx FROM events_wide) t
SELECT SUM(ma) AS s, MAX(ma) AS mx FROM (SELECT AVG(f07) OVER (PARTITION BY d03 ORDER BY id ROWS BETWEEN 9 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma FROM events_wide) t
SELECT d02, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY f08) AS med, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY i08) AS p90 FROM events_wide GROUP BY d02 ORDER BY d02
SELECT id, f09, d06 FROM events_wide ORDER BY f09, id
SELECT id, h01 FROM events_wide ORDER BY h01, id
SELECT id, d00, f09 FROM events_wide ORDER BY f09, id LIMIT 100 OFFSET 86
SELECT id, d00, f09 FROM events_wide ORDER BY id LIMIT 100 OFFSET 86
SELECT id, f09, h00 FROM events_wide ORDER BY f09 DESC, id LIMIT 100
SELECT * FROM events_wide ORDER BY f09 DESC, id LIMIT 100
SELECT h00, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(f00) AS s FROM events_wide GROUP BY h00 ORDER BY s DESC, h00 LIMIT 100
SELECT id, d00, h01, h02, f09 FROM events_wide ORDER BY h02, id LIMIT 10 OFFSET 95
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(b.f02) AS s FROM events_wide a JOIN events_wide b ON b.h00 = a.h07
SELECT order_id, customer_id, total FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND placed_at >= DATE '2025-04-01' AND placed_at < DATE '2025-07-01' ORDER BY total DESC, order_id LIMIT 25
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(total) AS revenue, AVG(total) AS avg_order FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT c.customer_id, c.segment, SUM(p.captured_amount) AS revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE p.status = 'captured' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.segment ORDER BY revenue DESC, c.customer_id LIMIT 20
SELECT p.category, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price * (1 - i.discount_pct)) AS net_revenue FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY net_revenue DESC

WITH returned_orders AS (SELECT DISTINCT i.order_id AS order_id FROM order_items i JOIN returns r ON r.item_id = i.item_id) SELECT o.customer_id, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders o WHERE o.order_id NOT IN (SELECT order_id FROM returned_orders) GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2

WITH product_revenue AS (SELECT p.category AS category, i.product_id AS product_id, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id GROUP BY p.category, i.product_id), ranked AS (SELECT category, product_id, revenue, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY ROUND(revenue::numeric, 4) DESC, product_id) AS rank FROM product_revenue) SELECT category, product_id, revenue, rank FROM ranked WHERE rank <= 3 ORDER BY category, rank

WITH cohorts AS (SELECT customer_id AS customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', joined_at) AS cohort_month FROM customers), returned_orders AS (SELECT DISTINCT i.order_id AS order_id FROM order_items i JOIN returns r ON r.item_id = i.item_id), captured AS (SELECT k.cohort_month AS cohort_month, o.customer_id AS customer_id, SUM(p.captured_amount) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN cohorts k ON k.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE p.status = 'captured' GROUP BY k.cohort_month, o.customer_id) SELECT cohort_month, COUNT(*) AS customers, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM captured GROUP BY cohort_month ORDER BY cohort_month

WITH per_customer AS (SELECT r.name AS region, c.segment AS segment, c.customer_id AS customer_id, SUM(p.captured_amount) AS revenue FROM regions r JOIN customers c ON c.region_id = r.region_id JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE p.status = 'captured' GROUP BY r.name, c.segment, c.customer_id) SELECT region, segment, COUNT(*) AS customers, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM per_customer GROUP BY region, segment ORDER BY region, segment

SELECT p.category, COUNT(*) AS items, COUNT(r.item_id) AS returns, COUNT(r.item_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS return_rate FROM products p JOIN order_items i ON i.product_id = p.product_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT item_id AS item_id FROM returns) r ON r.item_id = i.item_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category

SELECT j.name, SUM(t.tax_amount) AS tax_collected FROM order_taxes t JOIN tax_rates r ON r.tax_rate_id = t.tax_rate_id JOIN tax_jurisdictions j ON j.jurisdiction_id = r.jurisdiction_id GROUP BY j.name ORDER BY tax_collected DESC, j.name
SELECT kind, status, COUNT(*) AS transactions, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM payment_transactions GROUP BY kind, status ORDER BY kind, status

WITH discounts AS (SELECT order_id AS order_id, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM order_discounts GROUP BY order_id), taxes AS (SELECT order_id AS order_id, SUM(tax_amount) AS amount FROM order_taxes GROUP BY order_id) SELECT o.status, SUM(COALESCE(d.amount, 0)) AS discounts, SUM(COALESCE(t.amount, 0)) AS taxes FROM orders o LEFT JOIN discounts d ON d.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN taxes t ON t.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.status ORDER BY o.status
SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.status ORDER BY o.status
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items i JOIN returns r ON r.item_id = i.item_id WHERE i.order_id = o.order_id)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments p WHERE p.order_id = o.order_id AND p.status = 'captured')
SELECT ps.supplier_id, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(i.quantity) AS units FROM order_items i JOIN product_suppliers ps ON ps.product_id = i.product_id GROUP BY ps.supplier_id ORDER BY ps.supplier_id

SELECT order_id, total, placed_at
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'completed'
  AND placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
  AND total BETWEEN 20 AND 500
ORDER BY placed_at DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT order_id, status
FROM orders
WHERE status = ANY(ARRAY['returned', 'cancelled'])
  AND store_id <> ALL(ARRAY[1, 2])

SELECT r.return_id,
       CAST(r.returned_at AS TEXT) AS returned,
       r.returned_at - o.placed_at AS elapsed,
       (CAST(r.returned_at AS DATE) - CAST(o.placed_at AS DATE)) / 7 AS weeks_to_return
FROM returns r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
ORDER BY r.return_id
LIMIT 5

SELECT s.name AS store, COUNT(*) AS orders, ROUND(SUM(o.total)::NUMERIC, 2) AS revenue
FROM stores s
JOIN orders o ON o.store_id = s.store_id
LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.employee_id = o.employee_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.name
ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT p.category,
       COUNT(*) AS lines,
       COUNT(DISTINCT i.order_id) AS baskets,
       ROUND(SUM(i.line_total)::NUMERIC, 2) AS revenue,
       ROUND(AVG(i.line_total)::NUMERIC, 2) AS average_line,
       MIN(i.unit_price) AS cheapest,
       MAX(i.unit_price) AS dearest
FROM order_items i
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
HAVING SUM(i.line_total) > 10000
ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT DISTINCT ON (customer_id) customer_id, order_id, placed_at
FROM orders
ORDER BY customer_id, placed_at DESC

SELECT JSON_OBJECT(
  'id' VALUE o.order_id,
  'detail' VALUE JSON_OBJECT('status' VALUE o.status),
  'items' VALUE JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('sku' VALUE p.sku))
) AS document
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
GROUP BY o.order_id, o.status

SELECT c.customer_id,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(agg), '[]')
   FROM (SELECT o.order_id, o.total FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id) agg
  ) AS orders
FROM customers c
SELECT '{"sku": "A-1", "dims": {"w": 30, "h": 40}}'::json -> 'dims' ->> 'w' AS width

SELECT p.category,
       PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY i.line_total) AS median_line,
       PERCENTILE_DISC(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY i.line_total) AS p90_line,
       MODE() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY i.quantity) AS usual_quantity
FROM order_items i
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY median_line DESC

SELECT category, name, revenue
FROM (
  SELECT p.category, p.name, SUM(i.line_total) AS revenue,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(i.line_total) DESC) AS rank
  FROM order_items i
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
  GROUP BY p.category, p.name
) AS ranked
WHERE rank <= 3

SELECT item.sku, item.qty
FROM JSON_TABLE(
  '[{"sku":"A-1","qty":2},{"sku":"B-4","qty":1}]',
  '$[*]' COLUMNS (sku TEXT PATH '$.sku', qty INTEGER PATH '$.qty')
) AS item

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', placed_at) AS month, SUM(total) AS revenue
  FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', placed_at)
)
SELECT month, revenue,
       revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS change
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month

WITH RECURSIVE months(month) AS (
  SELECT TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT month + INTERVAL '1 month' FROM months WHERE month < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01'
)
SELECT month FROM months

SELECT day, COUNT(o.order_id) AS orders,
       EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM MAX(o.placed_at) - MIN(o.placed_at)) / 3600 AS busy_hours
FROM generate_series(TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01', TIMESTAMP '2025-03-31', INTERVAL '1 day') AS day
LEFT JOIN orders o ON DATE_TRUNC('day', o.placed_at) = day
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day

SELECT customer_id,
       placed_at,
       total,
       SUM(total) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY placed_at) AS running_total,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY total DESC) AS biggest_basket,
       LAG(placed_at) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY placed_at) AS previous_order
FROM orders

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', placed_at) AS month, SUM(total) AS revenue
  FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', placed_at)
)
SELECT month,
       revenue,
       revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS change,
       100.0 * revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER () AS pct_of_total
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month

SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
EXCEPT
SELECT customer_id FROM orders WHERE placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01'
